shell.changePasswordHint: Choose a new password for your account. You stay signed in.
shell.offline: You are offline. Changes will fail until the connection returns.
shell.serverUnreachable: The server cannot be reached. Retrying automatically.

palette.placeholder: Type a page, a knowledge base or an action

secret.onceTitle: Copy this now — it is shown only once
secret.onceBody: This value is not stored in a recoverable form. If you lose it you will have to issue a new one.
secret.acknowledge: I have saved this somewhere safe

login.headline: Knowledge, stacked for agents to find.
login.tagline: Upload documents, index them, and let any agent retrieve cited passages through one API.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account an administrator created for you.
login.firstRunHint: First run? The initial administrator password was printed once in the startup logs: docker compose logs migrate

credentials.title: Set your credentials
credentials.ledeInitial: This account is using a generated initial password. Choose new credentials to continue.
credentials.ledeAdminForced: An administrator has required a credential change on this account. Choose new credentials to continue.
credentials.usernameHint: Optional — leave as-is to keep the current username.

rule.classes: At least {n} of: lowercase, uppercase, digit, symbol

dashboard.lede: What needs attention, and where to pick up.

setup.title: Finish setting up
setup.description: Three steps before the first document can be indexed.
setup.modelHint: Point at the TEI or Infinity service and test it.
setup.storageHint: One binding for document files, one for vectors.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.reindexRequired: {kb} needs a rebuild to apply its new settings
attention.mcpError: The MCP service reported an error
attention.queueStalled: The {queue} queue has work waiting for {minutes} min

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.description: Agents call the retrieval API or the MCP endpoint with an API key.

knowledge.lede: Everything you index, searchable by people and agents.

empty.title: No knowledge bases yet
empty.description: Create one, upload documents, and search them within minutes.
empty.setupFirst: Register a model and add storage first; the setup steps above walk through it.

create.title: New knowledge base
create.description: The model and storage are fixed into the first index version.
create.modelHint: Changing the model later requires a rebuild.
create.strategyHint: Parent–child keeps small searchable chunks with wider context.
create.setupMissing: An administrator must register an embedding model and add document and vector storage first.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: All documents, chunks and vectors are removed. API keys scoped to it lose that scope.
delete.failed: Could not delete the knowledge base

rebuild.title: Rebuild the index?
rebuild.description: About {chunks} chunks will be re-embedded, roughly {minutes} min. Search keeps using the current index until the new one is ready.

access.blockedBody: You manage this knowledge base but do not have content access. Open a time-limited, audited window to read its documents.
access.dialogBody: The owner is notified and the reason is recorded in the audit log.
access.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Say what you need to look at and why.
access.ttlHint: Leave empty to use the workspace default.

documents.selectHint: Select a document to see its progress, errors and chunks.
documents.selectHintEmpty: Uploaded documents appear here with their indexing progress.
documents.failedHint: Correct the source or the deployment and retry. Invalid source bytes need a new upload.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.description: Upload Markdown, text, HTML, JSON, Office files, PDFs or scanned images. Scans use OCR.
empty.readOnly: Nothing has been uploaded to this knowledge base.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: Its chunks and vectors are removed from the index.

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.empty: No chunks were produced for this document.
chunks.pending: Chunks appear once the document is indexed.
chunks.lockedDuringBuild: Editing is paused while an index is building.
chunks.childEditHint: Saving re-embeds this one chunk. Parent context is not expanded for this knowledge base until the next rebuild.
chunks.parentEditHint: Parent chunks are not searched. Saving changes the context returned with its child chunks.
chunks.savedHint: The searchable vector updates in the background.

search.placeholder: Ask a question or paste a phrase from your documents
search.hint: Runs the same query an agent would run, with your knowledge base defaults.
search.noResultsHint: Try other words, switch to full text, or check that the documents are indexed.

versions.lede: Each rebuild creates a new version. Search uses the active one; failed builds keep their error so they stay diagnosable.
versions.empty: No index has been built yet.

general.title: General
general.modelFrozen: The embedding model is fixed per index version. Rebuild to move to a different vector space.

retrieval.title: Retrieval defaults
retrieval.description: Applied to every query that does not override them, including agents.
retrieval.expandParentHint: Indexes built before parent snapshots existed return the child chunk with a notice instead.
retrieval.rerankHint: The name of a rerank endpoint configured by the operator.

chunking.title: Chunking
chunking.description: Changes apply on the next rebuild, not to the current index.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting removes every document, chunk and vector. This cannot be undone.

models.title: Models
models.lede: The embedding service used to index documents and embed queries.

provider.title: Providers
provider.description: TEI and Infinity endpoints this deployment may call.
provider.addHint: The local Compose service is http://embedding:80. Only add addresses you trust.
provider.emptyBody: Add the local embedding service to begin.
provider.endpointHint: Private addresses require the checkbox below.
provider.revisionHint: A label for the deployed model files, recorded in each index version.
provider.deleteBody: Providers with registered models cannot be deleted.

model.title: Models
model.description: Dimensions and the token limit must match the deployed model.
model.addHint: Defaults match the bundled MiniLM model.
model.emptyBody: Register the model served by your provider, then test it.
model.tokenizerHint: A tokenizer deployed with this server.
model.testFailed: The endpoint did not return a valid embedding.
model.deleteBody: Models used by a knowledge base cannot be deleted.

storage.title: Storage
storage.lede: Where document files are kept and where vectors are indexed.
storage.addHint: The binding is tested right after it is created.
storage.emptyBody: Add one binding for document files and one for vectors before creating a knowledge base.
storage.localHint: Local files in the persistent directory configured by the deployment.
storage.pgvectorHint: pgvector indexes in the platform's PostgreSQL database.
storage.testFailed: Storage connection failed. Check the deployment configuration.
storage.deleteBody: Only unused bindings can be deleted. The underlying volume is not touched.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Administrators manage the platform; regular users work inside the knowledge bases they are granted.

roleHints.admin: Manages users, models, storage and settings.
roleHints.user: Works inside the knowledge bases they are granted.

users.forceChangeBody: Their current sessions end and they must choose a new password at the next sign-in.
users.forceChangeDone: Password change required at next sign-in.
users.confirmDelete: Their API keys and grants are revoked as well.
users.initialPasswordHint: Hand it to the user directly. They must change it at first sign-in, so this is a one-time handover credential, not a password you keep.

grants.title: Permissions — {name}
grants.effectiveHint: What the system actually evaluates, including role-implied capabilities and implication (kb:manage satisfies kb:read).
grants.heldHint: The rows that were written. Revoke one to take that access away.

keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: Credentials agents and applications use to call the retrieval API and MCP.
keys.createHint: The key is shown once after it is created.
keys.emptyBody: Create a key, scope it to the knowledge bases an agent needs, and copy it once.
keys.scopesHint: A key never exceeds its owner's permissions; the intersection is recomputed on every request.
keys.knowledgeBasesHint: Leave all unchecked to cover every knowledge base the owner can reach.
keys.noKnowledgeBases: No knowledge bases exist yet; the key will cover any the owner can reach.
keys.expiresHint: Optional. The key stops working at this time.
keys.ipAllowlistHint: Comma-separated. Requests from other addresses are rejected.
keys.confirmRevoke: Every copy of this key stops working immediately.
keys.allOwnerKbs: All knowledge bases the owner can reach
keys.keyHint: Store it in your secrets manager now. Only a hash is kept, so it cannot be shown again.
keys.intersectionExplainer: A key's effective permission is the intersection of its scopes and its owner's permissions, recomputed on every request. Revoking a user's access narrows all of their keys at once.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Send the key as a bearer token. The example targets your first knowledge base.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only. Every credential, permission and administrative change.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace policy. Hot settings apply immediately; the rest need a restart.
settings.restartNeeded: These settings take effect after a restart: {keys}
settings.accessTitle: Administrator access to knowledge base content
settings.accessDescription: Whether administrators can read documents in knowledge bases they were not granted.

break_glass.label: Temporary access
break_glass.detail: Administrators manage knowledge bases but must open a time-limited window with a reason to read content. The grant is audited and the owner is notified.

on_grant.label: Only when granted
on_grant.detail: Administrators read content only when the owner grants it directly.

always.label: Always
always.detail: Administrators can read every knowledge base. Fine for a single team; a compliance problem when teams share a deployment.

settings.limitsDescription: Defaults for new keys and sessions, and how long records are kept.
settings.queuesHint: The oldest waiting task is the signal: depth alone can look fine while one task sits behind a saturated workspace.

mcp.title: MCP service
mcp.subtitle: The managed listener that exposes knowledge bases as tools to MCP clients.
mcp.deploymentNotConfigured: This deployment does not manage an MCP listener. Settings and actions stay disabled until an operator enables it.

actions.accepted: {action} requested; waiting for the supervisor to confirm.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.hint: Shown only while the listener is confirmed running. Access still requires an API key.

config.title: Configuration
config.hint: Ports come from the deployment allowlist. Hosts and origins are one per line.
config.saved: Configuration saved; the supervisor is applying it.

logs.title: Recent logs
logs.hint: Service and request metadata only; never secrets or document content.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check that the service is running.
errors.pageLoad: The page could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
